title: Around the World in Eighty Days
description: Phileas Fogg and his companion Passepartout race across continents to win a wager, confronting delays, danger and a persistent detective.

title: King Solomon's Mines
description: Allan Quatermain guides an expedition across southern Africa in search of a missing man and a legendary treasure, encountering a hidden kingdom and a struggle for power.

title: The Railway Children
description: After a family crisis, three siblings move to the countryside and form friendships with railway workers and passengers while hoping for their father to return.

title: A Little Princess
description: Sara Crewe loses her privileged place at a boarding school and faces poverty and mistreatment, relying on imagination, friendship and kindness to endure.

title: Middlemarch
description: The ambitions and marriages of residents in a provincial English town intertwine as Dorothea Brooke and Tertius Lydgate confront social expectations and disappointed ideals.

title: The Mill on the Floss
description: Maggie and Tom Tulliver grow up beside their family mill, where financial hardship, sibling loyalty and conflicting expectations shape their adult lives.

title: David Copperfield
description: David recounts his difficult childhood, schooling, work and relationships as he grows toward independence and discovers the people and values that shape his life.

title: Rebecca of Sunnybrook Farm
description: An imaginative girl leaves her large family to live with two aunts in Maine, where school, friendship and strict expectations guide her growth into a young woman.

title: Phantastes: A Faerie Romance for Men and Women
description: Anodos enters a shifting fairy world of enchanted forests, strange companions and unsettling trials, undertaking a dreamlike journey of desire and self-discovery.

title: The Princess and the Goblin
description: Princess Irene and the miner Curdie become allies when underground goblins threaten her mountain kingdom, with a mysterious grandmother offering unexpected guidance.

title: The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
description: A London lawyer investigates the connection between a respected physician and a violent stranger, uncovering a troubling experiment in identity and moral responsibility.

title: The Castle of Otranto
description: A ruler attempts to secure his dynasty after a bizarre death at his castle, while supernatural events and concealed family histories threaten his plans.

title: Ivanhoe
description: In medieval England, a disinherited Saxon knight becomes entangled in tournaments, captivity and political conflict during the reign of Richard the Lionheart.

title: The Count of Monte Cristo
description: Wrongfully imprisoned Edmond Dantes escapes and acquires a fortune, then returns to post-Napoleonic French society with an elaborate plan against those who betrayed him.

title: A Study in Scarlet
description: Dr. Watson meets Sherlock Holmes and joins his investigation into a London murder whose apparently inexplicable clues connect to a long-hidden history.

title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
description: Holmes and Watson examine a suspicious death and threats against a family heir on Dartmoor, separating a terrifying legend from human motives.

title: Emma
description: Emma Woodhouse believes she understands everyone else's romantic prospects, but her matchmaking in Highbury exposes mistaken judgments and her own unrecognized feelings.

title: Sense and Sensibility
description: Elinor and Marianne Dashwood navigate reduced circumstances, uncertain courtships and disappointment, testing the balance between emotional openness and careful judgment.

title: The War of the Worlds
description: An unnamed narrator struggles through southern England as an invasion from Mars overwhelms human defenses and transforms ordinary life into a fight for survival.

title: A Journey to the Centre of the Earth
description: A professor, his nephew and their guide descend through an Icelandic volcano, following an old manuscript into a fantastic subterranean world.

title: Business Ethics
description: Examines how ethical reasoning informs business decisions, covering stakeholders, corporate responsibility, workplace obligations and the tensions between profit and public interests.

title: Principles of Marketing
description: Introduces customer-focused marketing through research, segmentation, branding, pricing, distribution and promotion, with attention to digital channels and ethical decisions.

title: Calculus Volume 2
description: Develops integral calculus, techniques and applications of integration, sequences, series, and parametric and polar representations for further mathematical and engineering study.

title: University Physics Volume 2
description: Develops calculus-based thermodynamics, electricity and magnetism, connecting mathematical models with worked examples and physical applications.

title: Ethics in Law Enforcement
description: Introduces ethical theories and professional accountability in policing, using issues such as discretion, authority, loyalty and investigative conduct. Its legal examples focus on Canada.

title: Introduction to Criminal Investigation: Processes, Practices and Thinking
description: Explains investigative reasoning alongside incident response, evidence handling, witness management, interviews and crime-scene practice. Canadian examples illustrate methods rather than Philippine legal procedure.

title: Human Resources in the Food Service and Hospitality Industry
description: Introduces hospitality staffing through recruitment, job analysis, employee development, performance management, compensation and workplace safety. Employment-law examples refer to British Columbia.

title: Working in the Food Service Industry
description: Covers professionalism, food-service occupations, communication, teamwork, time management and job-search skills, with employment-standards examples from British Columbia.

title: Teaching in a Digital Age
description: Offers a framework for choosing teaching methods and educational technologies, connecting learning theories, course design, media selection and support for digital learners.

title: Teaching Crowds: Learning and Social Media
description: Explores how people learn through groups, networks and online communities, examining social software and approaches to designing connected educational experiences.

title: Understanding Music: Past and Present
description: Introduces musical elements and listening skills, then surveys Western music from early traditions to modern styles and popular music in the United States.

title: Resonances: Engaging Music in Its Cultural Context
description: Explores music through its social purposes, including storytelling, political expression, spirituality, dance and entertainment, drawing examples from classical, popular and folk traditions.

title: Think Python: How to Think Like a Computer Scientist (2nd Edition)
description: Builds introductory Python programming skills through functions, iteration, recursion, data structures and object-oriented design, with progressively developed examples and exercises.

title: Think Java: How to Think Like a Computer Scientist
description: Introduces programming and computer science using Java, progressing from variables and control flow to methods, arrays, recursion and object-oriented problem solving.

title: Principles of Social Psychology: 1st International Edition
description: Introduces social cognition, attitudes, identity, relationships, group processes and intergroup behavior through research and practical examples. This version adds interactive activities to the international edition.

title: Fundamentals of Psychological Disorders
description: Introduces approaches to classification, assessment and treatment of psychological disorders, followed by disorder-focused modules. The linked fourth edition reflects DSM-5-TR terminology.

title: Nursing Fundamentals
description: Introduces nursing practice, communication, clinical judgment and patient-care concepts using the nursing process. The second edition aligns examples with the Wisconsin nursing curriculum and updated exam frameworks.

title: Nursing Skills
description: Provides entry-level nursing skill procedures and assessment guidance, connecting preparation, safe performance, documentation and evaluation with clinical judgment.
